glosses.notes: Usually refers to electric power supply or power generation capacity in homes, factories, and cities.

examples.sentence: 今年夏天太热，城里用电一直上升，所以有关部门提前检查电力系统，怕晚上大家回家以后同时开空调会出问题。
山里的工厂以前一到下雨就不能工作，现在路和电力都稳定多了，老板才敢接时间更紧的新订单。
新闻说那边风大太阳也足，所以不少地方想靠风和太阳提供更稳定的电力，让冬天用电别那么紧。

example_translations.translation: This summer has been so hot that electricity use in the city keeps rising, so the relevant departments inspected the power system early because they worried problems would happen at night when everyone got home and turned on the air conditioner at the same time.

Factories in the mountains used to be unable to keep working whenever it rained, but now the roads and electric power are much more stable, so the owner finally dares to accept new orders with tighter deadlines.

The news said that the wind is strong and the sun is plentiful there, so many places want to use wind and sunlight to provide more stable electric power, so winter electricity use will not feel so strained.

glosses.notes: A physical shop or storefront that does business on a street or in a market.

examples.sentence: 这条老街重新修好以后，原来快关门的小店铺慢慢又亮起灯，晚上来散步的人也比以前多了很多。
这家店铺在学校门口开门以后，来买东西的人很多，所以老板每天下午都要重新安排第二天卖什么。
下雨那天我们为了躲雨走进一家小店铺，结果老板看我们衣服都湿了，先拿纸让我们擦一擦再慢慢看书。

example_translations.translation: After this old street was repaired again, the small shops that had almost closed slowly lit up again, and far more people came for evening walks than before.
After this shop opened by the school gate, many people came to buy things there, so every afternoon the owner had to rearrange what would be sold the next day.

That rainy day, we stepped into a small shop to get out of the rain. When the owner saw that our clothes were soaked, he first handed us paper to dry off a little before we slowly looked at the books.

glosses.notes: Used for a source of electricity, a power supply unit, or the place a device gets power.

examples.sentence: 会议开始前，大家发现电源没有接好，只好先在桌子下面检查线，看看是不是松了。
她出门前总会再看一眼厨房的电源和开关，因为上次忘了关机器，回来以后家里一直有奇怪的声音。
这台旧电脑换了新的电源以后，开机总算不再突然断掉，办公室里的人也不用轮流帮他保存文件了。

example_translations.translation: Before the meeting started, everyone noticed that the power source was not connected properly, so they had to check the cable under the table to see whether it had come loose.

Before leaving home, she always looks once more at the kitchen power source and switches, because last time she forgot to turn off a machine and there was a strange sound in the house the whole time after she came back.
After this old computer got a new power supply, it finally stopped cutting out suddenly when starting up, and people in the office no longer had to take turns helping him save files.

glosses.notes: Used when something hangs in the air or is suspended from above.

examples.sentence: 为了欢迎大家，老师把写着名字的大牌子吊在门口，大家一到这里就知道今天要在这里上课。
修灯的师傅把旧灯慢慢吊下来以后，先站在下面看了半天，才说这根线比大家想的老得多。
奶奶把晒好的辣椒吊在窗边通风的地方，说这样既不占桌子，又能让家里一直有点香味。

example_translations.translation: To welcome everyone, the teacher hung a large sign with the name on it at the entrance, so as soon as people arrived they knew they would be having class here today.
After the repair worker slowly lowered the old lamp down, he stood underneath and looked at it for quite a while before saying that this wire was much older than everyone had thought.
Grandma hung the dried peppers by the window where air could pass through, saying that this way they would not take up table space and the house could keep a bit of fragrance all the time.

glosses.notes: Can mean transferring a person to a new post or mobilizing people, resources, or enthusiasm.

examples.sentence: 公司决定把他调动到南方工作时，他先怕孩子不适应，后来才发现全家都很喜欢那里的生活。
这位老师上课厉害的地方，不是声音特别大，而是总能调动学生主动问问题，让一节课很快就活起来。
为了把演出办好，负责人临时调动了几组年轻志愿者去入口帮忙，所以排队的人没有越等越乱。

example_translations.translation: When the company decided to transfer him to work in the south, he was first afraid the child would not adjust, but later he realized the whole family liked life there very much.
What is impressive about this teacher is not that her voice is especially loud, but that she can always get students to start asking questions on their own, making a class come alive very quickly.

To make the performance go well, the person in charge temporarily mobilized several groups of young volunteers to help at the entrance, so the people in line did not become more and more chaotic as they waited.

glosses.notes: To catch fish with a rod, line, or hook; often used for leisure fishing.

examples.sentence: 周末天刚亮，他就背着旧椅子和水壶去河边钓鱼，说自己最喜欢那种天还没热起来的安静时候。
爷爷带孩子去钓鱼，不是一定要把鱼带回家，而是想让他慢慢学会坐一会儿再等。
本来大家只是出去散步，结果走到桥下看见不少人在钓鱼，我们就在旁边坐了半天，看谁先把鱼拉上来。

example_translations.translation: As soon as it got light on the weekend, he carried an old chair and a water bottle to the river to fish, saying that he likes most the quiet time before the day has really become hot.
Grandpa took the child fishing not because he absolutely needed to bring fish home, but because he wanted him to slowly learn how to sit for a while and wait.
At first everyone had only gone out for a walk, but when we reached the bridge and saw many people fishing, we sat nearby for a long time to see who would pull up a fish first.

glosses.notes: Used when prices, numbers, or people fall downward.

examples.sentence: 这家店刚开业时很热闹，可是服务一直没有跟上，网上的评价后来跌得很快，老板这才着急重新培训员工。
医生说他不是大问题，只是昨天没吃早饭又站太久，所以血压一下子跌了下来，休息一会儿就好多了。
新闻里说水果今年更多了，所以市场上的价格这几天跌了不少，来买的人也多了。

example_translations.translation: This shop was lively when it first opened, but the service never kept up, so the online reviews later fell quickly and only then did the owner hurry to train the staff again.
The doctor said it was not a serious problem. He had just skipped breakfast yesterday and stood too long, so his blood pressure suddenly dropped, and after resting for a while he felt much better.
The news said there is more fruit this year, so market prices have fallen quite a bit these past few days, and more people have come to buy it too.

glosses.notes: In these examples 顶 means to brace or support something from below; the word can also mean the top of something.

examples.sentence: 那扇门突然往里倒的时候，两个年轻人先用东西把它顶住，等人来了再慢慢修。
下雨的时候，他一边用手顶着上面的大布，一边让大家先往里去，别在外面等。
他搬家时一个人抬不动床板，只好先拿几本厚书把一头顶起来，再一点一点把轮子装上去。

example_translations.translation: When that door suddenly started falling inward, two young people first used something to brace it up, then waited for someone to come and repair it slowly.
While it was raining, he held up the big cloth above with one hand and told everyone to go farther inside first instead of waiting outside.
While moving house, he could not lift the bed board alone, so he first used several thick books to prop up one end, then installed the wheels little by little.

glosses.notes: A commercial order placed by a customer or business.

examples.sentence: 直播那天晚上订单一下子涨得太快，客服只好临时加班回消息，连仓库也忙到半夜还没有完全发完。
这家店以前只接小订单，后来来的人越来越多，所以老板决定请人专门回电话。
客户改了三次颜色以后，老板还是把订单重新发了一遍，怕工厂看错以后直接做。

example_translations.translation: On the night of the livestream, orders suddenly increased too quickly, so customer service had to work overtime to reply to messages, and even the warehouse stayed busy until midnight without finishing all the shipments.
This shop used to take only small orders, but later more and more people started coming, so the owner decided to hire someone just to return phone calls.
After the customer changed the color three times, the owner still sent the order again because he was afraid the factory would misread it and start making it right away.

glosses.notes: To formally agree to marry, often with both families involved.

examples.sentence: 他们决定订婚以后，没有马上发很多消息，只先把双方父母请到一起吃饭，想把以后住哪儿慢慢谈清楚。
表姐订婚那天，外婆比谁都早到饭店，一边帮忙看花，一边不停问我们照片拍得好不好。
他原来打算旅行回来再谈订婚的事，可是一见到对方家里那么认真准备，反而更想早点把时间定下来。

example_translations.translation: After deciding to get engaged, they did not immediately send out lots of messages. They first invited both sets of parents to eat together because they wanted to slowly talk through where they would live afterward.
On the day my older cousin got engaged, Grandma arrived at the restaurant earlier than anyone else, helping to watch over the flowers while constantly asking us whether the photos looked good.

He had originally planned to talk about getting engaged after coming back from the trip, but as soon as he saw how seriously the other family was preparing, he wanted even more to settle the timing soon.

glosses.notes: Used for deciding or discussing the selling price of a product or service.

examples.sentence: 这件衣服的定价虽然高，可是大家看材料和细节以后，都觉得值。
老板没有急着给新产品定价，而是先去几家同类店看了看，想知道顾客到底最在意什么。
这次展览的票定价不低，可是里面准备得很细，所以很多人看完还是觉得值。

example_translations.translation: Although the pricing of this piece of clothing is high, after looking at the material and the details, everyone feels it is worth it.
The owner did not rush to set a price for the new product. Instead, he first visited several similar shops because he wanted to know what customers really cared about most.
The ticket pricing for this exhibition is not low, but everything inside was prepared with care, so many people still felt it was worth it after they finished viewing it.

glosses.notes: Used when something is scheduled to start, stop, or happen at a set time.

examples.meaning_en: to set for a fixed time
examples.sentence: 她怕自己早上起不来，就把灯定时在六点开，这样一醒就知道不能再睡了。
食堂最近把热汤改成定时供应，因为下午晚一点来的人不多，厨房这样安排更不容易浪费。
为了让会议准时结束，老师定时提醒大家，一到时间就先停下来，别越说越远。

example_translations.translation: She was afraid she would not get up in the morning, so she set the light to come on at six. That way, as soon as she woke up, she knew she could not go back to sleep.
The cafeteria recently changed the hot soup to timed service because not many people come a little later in the afternoon, and this arrangement makes it less likely that the kitchen will waste food.
To make the meeting end on time, the teacher reminds everyone at set times, so when the time comes people stop first instead of drifting farther and farther off topic.

glosses.notes: Can mean finding a location or defining a product or person's position in a market or role.

examples.sentence: 山里信号不好的时候，大家只能先看手机定位，再一条一条地往里找人。
这个品牌重新定位以后，不再什么年龄的人都想抓住，而是把主要产品慢慢转向年轻上班族。
老师说这篇文章最难的不是找资料，而是先给自己的观点定位，不然写到后面很容易什么都想说。

example_translations.translation: When the signal in the mountains is bad, people can only first check the phone location and then search inward one route at a time.
After this brand repositioned itself, it no longer tried to appeal to every age group. Instead, it gradually shifted its main products toward young office workers.
The teacher said that the hardest part of this essay is not finding material, but first positioning your own viewpoint. Otherwise, by the end it is easy to want to say everything.

glosses.notes: Used for explaining exactly what something means or how it should be understood.

examples.sentence: 老师没有直接背书上的定义，而是先让大家举生活里的例子，这样一讲到概念时就没有那么空了。
两个部门对“完成”这个词的定义一直不一样，所以同一件事明明做完了，开会时还是总有人说没做完。
记者问他怎么定义成功，他想了很久才说，现在更在意每天是不是有力气做自己觉得重要的事。

example_translations.translation: The teacher did not directly recite the definition from the book. Instead, she first had everyone give examples from daily life, so when the concept came up it did not feel so empty.
The two departments have always had different definitions of the word “finished,” so even when the same task is clearly done, someone still says in meetings that it has not been completed.
A reporter asked him how he defines success, and after thinking for a long time he said that now he cares more about whether he has the energy each day to do what he feels is important.

glosses.notes: To make or adjust something for a particular person's needs.

examples.sentence: 她给爸爸定制了一本小相册，把这些年全家一起出门的票和照片都放进去，生日那天一翻开大家就笑了。
这家厂虽然不大，却能按照客人的身高和工作环境定制桌子，所以不少公司愿意多等半个月。
为了让第一次来的客人也觉得方便，店里把最受欢迎的几种定制方案直接挂在墙上，省得大家不知道从哪儿问起。

example_translations.translation: She customized a small photo album for her father, putting in the tickets and pictures from the family's outings over the years, and on his birthday everyone laughed as soon as they opened it.
Although this factory is not large, it can customize desks according to a customer's height and work environment, so many companies are willing to wait an extra half month.
To make first-time customers feel it was easy too, the shop hung several of the most popular custom-order plans directly on the wall, saving everyone from not knowing where to start asking.

glosses.notes: Classifier for buildings such as houses, office towers, and apartment blocks.

examples.sentence: 我们学校后面新盖的那栋楼还没正式开门，很多学生已经开始猜哪一层以后会先给谁用。
房东先介绍这栋楼早上太阳进来多不多，因为他知道我们最在意里面亮不亮。
那栋楼外面很普通，可是进去以后，大家就会看到里面的照片。

example_translations.translation: The new building behind our school has not officially opened yet, but many students have already started guessing which floor will be assigned for use first.
The landlord first explained whether the morning sun comes well into this building, because he knew we cared most about whether it felt bright inside.
That building looks ordinary from the outside, but once people go in, they immediately notice the photos inside.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to the reason or driving motive behind an action or decision.

examples.sentence: 大家觉得他的解释可以，可是真正的动机还是要查，后面的事才会清楚。
老师批改申请书时最看重的，不是你写过多少活动，而是想知道你的动机到底真不真诚。
她决定辞职并不是一时冲动，真正的动机是想把照顾父母和重新学习这两件事排到前面。

example_translations.translation: People feel that his explanation is possible, but the real motive still has to be investigated before what happened afterward becomes clear.
When the teacher grades application letters, what matters most is not how many activities you have listed, but whether your motivation is truly sincere.
Her decision to quit was not a moment of impulse. The real motive was that she wanted to put caring for her parents and resuming her studies first.

glosses.notes: Can mean motivating force in people or the power that makes a machine move.

examples.sentence: 项目做到一半最难的时候，真正让团队坚持下去的动力，不是奖金，而是大家都不想白白浪费前面那几个月。
这辆车开的时候动力很大，所以大家还是喜欢它，虽然它看起来很普通。
他以前总把别人的表扬当动力，后来慢慢发现，如果心里没有自己的目标，很快还是会累。

example_translations.translation: When the project reached its hardest point halfway through, the real driving force that kept the team going was not the bonus, but the fact that nobody wanted to waste the previous few months for nothing.
This car has plenty of power when it is running, so people still like it even though it looks quite ordinary.
He used to treat other people's praise as his driving force, but later he slowly realized that if you do not have your own goals in your heart, you still get tired very quickly.

glosses.notes: A general term for animation and related comics culture.

examples.sentence: 这家书店晚上也放动漫，来的人很多，大家一看就不想马上走。
她学设计以后才发现，做好一部动漫不只是会画人物，还得懂声音、节奏和镜头怎么一起配合。
爸爸原来以为动漫只是给孩子看的，后来陪儿子看完那部片子，反而先被里面的音乐和故事打动了。

example_translations.translation: This bookstore also plays animation at night, and lots of people come. Once they start watching, nobody wants to leave right away.
Only after studying design did she realize that making a good animated work is not just about drawing characters. You also have to understand how sound, rhythm, and camera shots work together.
Dad originally thought anime was only for children, but after watching that film with his son, he was the first one moved by the music and story inside it.

glosses.notes: Often means the latest developments, changing conditions, or a dynamic state.

examples.sentence: 出差的人一上车就先看天气和路况动态，怕前面那段山路一下雨又要临时封上几个小时。
公司内部每天都会发项目动态，不是为了让大家紧张，而是怕信息绕来绕去以后越来越不准确。
她研究这个行业很多年，所以一看到市场动态有点变，马上就能猜到哪些小店下个月会先受影响。

example_translations.translation: As soon as people on business trips get into the car, they first check weather and traffic updates because they are afraid that stretch of mountain road will be temporarily closed again for several hours once it starts raining.
The company sends project updates internally every day, not to make everyone nervous, but because they fear that if information keeps circulating indirectly, it will become less and less accurate.
She has studied this industry for many years, so as soon as she sees the market trend shift a little, she can immediately guess which small shops will be affected first next month.

glosses.notes: Describes a voice, song, or speech that sounds especially beautiful or appealing.

examples.sentence: 她的声音不高，可是一说话就很动听，所以大家后来都把手机放下，认真听她讲。
这首歌最打动人的地方，不是唱得多难，而是从前面到后面都很动听，让人听完以后很久还记得。
老师一开口就很动听，所以大家都安静下来，只想继续听下去。

example_translations.translation: Her voice is not loud, but as soon as she starts speaking it is very pleasant to listen to, so later everyone put down their phones and listened carefully to her.
What moves people most about this song is not how hard it is to sing, but that it sounds pleasant from beginning to end, so people still remember it long after hearing it.
The moment the teacher started speaking, it sounded very pleasant, so everyone quieted down and only wanted to keep listening.

glosses.notes: Can mean playfully teasing someone or being amusing enough to make people laugh.

examples.sentence: 他知道妹妹刚哭过，还是一直逗她笑，结果旁边的大人也都笑了。
这位主持人很会逗现场的人开口，不用一直喊，也能让原来有点冷的气氛慢慢热起来。
奶奶说孙子太调皮，可是他一学大人说话，她就笑，说这孩子逗。

example_translations.translation: He knew his little sister had just been crying, but he still kept teasing her until she laughed, and in the end the adults nearby were laughing too.
This host is very good at teasing people on site into speaking up. Without shouting all the time, he can still gradually warm up an atmosphere that had originally been a little cold.
Grandma says her grandson is too mischievous, but as soon as he starts imitating the way adults talk, she laughs and says the child is funny.

glosses.notes: Used for a hard struggle against a problem, pressure, or opponent.

examples.sentence: 医生说接下来的治疗像一场很长的斗争，家里人听完都沉默了，但还是决定轮流陪他把每一步走完。
这几年小店跟高房租和网店竞争一直在斗争，所以老板一有空就站在门口看别人到底为什么愿意进来。
她不是喜欢跟人斗争，只是觉得如果连明显不合理的安排都不说，以后吃亏的人只会越来越多。

example_translations.translation: The doctor said the treatment ahead would be like a long struggle. After hearing that, the family all fell silent, but they still decided to take turns staying with him through every step.

These past few years, the small shop has been struggling against high rent and competition from online stores, so whenever the owner has time, he stands at the door to see why people are willing to come in.
It is not that she likes struggling with people. She just feels that if no one even speaks up about clearly unreasonable arrangements, more and more people will keep ending up at a disadvantage.

glosses.notes: A modern large city, often with emphasis on urban life and pace.

examples.sentence: 他在小城长大，第一次一个人搬到大都市以后，最不习惯的不是房租，而是每天走到哪儿都像在赶时间。
他在都市工作以后，每天下班回家都很晚，可是他还是觉得这里机会多。
在都市里，老人和孩子下楼就能坐一会儿，所以大家都喜欢这样的地方。

example_translations.translation: He grew up in a small city, and after moving alone to a metropolis for the first time, what he found hardest to get used to was not the rent, but the feeling that every day everywhere people were in a hurry.
After he started working in the metropolis, he got home late from work every day, but he still felt there were more opportunities here.
In a metropolis, if older people and children can come downstairs and sit for a while, everyone likes that kind of place.

glosses.notes: Can refer to poison itself, something poisonous, or sharp biting language that feels harmful.

examples.sentence: 老师提醒我们，实验室里的液体如果没有名字就别用手去碰，因为里面可能有毒。
这东西颜色很漂亮，可是老人说它有毒，所以大家都不吃。
他说人的话太毒，所以大家听了以后都不想再说了。

example_translations.translation: The teacher reminded us that if a liquid in the laboratory does not have a label, we should not touch it with our hands, because it may be poisonous.
This thing looks beautiful in color, but the older people say it is poisonous, so nobody eats it.
The things he says about people are too cutting, so after hearing them everyone no longer wants to keep talking.
